newsitem.title: USA: Four Corners 750 MW coal unit seen restarting Fri.
newsitem.headline: Four Corners 750 MW coal unit seen restarting Fri.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in New Mexico is expected to restart late Friday, reaching full power sometime on Saturday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Wednesday.
The unit has been down since mid-May for scheduled maintenance work.
Four Corners' other 750 MW, two 185 MW and one 245 MW units were said to be operating at full load.
Arizona Public Service Co operates Four Corners and owns units 1, 2 and 3 along with 15 percent of units 4 and 5.
Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake in units 4 and 5.
